title: Consistency of velopharyngeal function assessment results after Furlow palatoplasty
html: The aim of this study was to assess the changes in postoperative velopharyngeal function (VPF) over time, and factors associated with these changes, in patients who underwent Furlow palatoplasty between January 2015 and December 2023. This retrospective cohort study included patients who underwent surgery for primary cleft palate repair or secondary correction of velopharyngeal dysfunction. No speech therapy or other palatopharyngeal treatments were performed. VPF was evaluated during two follow-up visits at least 6 months apart, with the first no earlier than 6 months post-surgery.
